reply_text:
I answered Marcus in the #north-team thread: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals is **Thea Ramaswell**, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

The answer comes from Dana's 20 Aug 2025 message in #north-team, where she said Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again on the morning shift. Marcus is in that channel, so he can see it himself. In the same thread Dana gave the cause: a driver checked in at the kiosk, then dispatch added him again by hand, so the same trailer showed up twice. My reply also suggested checking with Dana, since she owns the account and was following up.

One small error in what I posted: I said "Dana and Ilse" explained the cause, but only Dana did. Ilse just asked which export it was. The contact name and the cause are correct.

The seat count and amendment details in that same thread are operational facts, not finance figures, and I didn't include them anyway. I didn't use anything from channels or files Marcus can't see.
